data.rationale: The proposal captures the right overall flow (Wikipedia, then Booking, then Notes, with the same note template), but it has only one date parameter and hardcodes a one-night stay for 2 adults instead of using separate checkin and checkout parameters. It also replaces the "first property with a review score of 8 or more" rule with "top result", leaves out the Do-not-Reserve constraint, and doesn't open the property page, so an automation built from it would pick the wrong hotel and miss the checkout date.
